query:
SELECT s.name, p.label, p.year, p.month,
  pf.openingStock, pf.adjustments, pf.invoiced, pf.arrivals,
  im.value as ims_value,
  fd.value as forecast_value
FROM skus s
JOIN periods p ON 1=1
LEFT JOIN planning_fg_data pf ON pf.skuId = s.id AND pf.periodId = p.id
LEFT JOIN ims_data im ON im.skuId = s.id AND im.periodId = p.id
LEFT JOIN forecast_data fd ON fd.skuId = s.id AND fd.periodId = p.id
WHERE s.name LIKE '%Blueberry Mint%' AND s.weight = '50g'
  AND p.year = 2025
ORDER BY p.year, p.month;
